content.comment_body: Hello, I am using [product_name] [article_no] and [product_name]. Currently, my [product_name] cannot establish a connection to the [product_name] Basis Module. The error message states: "ERROR Secure connection to [product_name] BM [version_no] or higher cannot be established; [product_name] BM not reachable or wrong version." I am able to send test SMS messages successfully and receive both test confirmations and error notifications on my phone via SMS. The IP address of the [product_name] BM is set to 192.168.0.5, while the [product_name] uses 192.168.0.3. Interestingly, if I try to ping the [product_name] BM at 192.168.0.5, it responds with "[product_name] BM is not reachable." If I update the BM address in the monitoring software to 192.168.0.3, then it claims the BM is reachable, but shows a warning/error: "The connection to [product_name] BM cannot be enabled because [product_name] BM and [product_name] CMR use the same IP address."
Occasionally, I also receive SMS from the [product_name] communication module indicating: ERROR Connection to [product_name] BM aborted.

Consider opening a support request. In the German-language section of the forum, another user reported experiencing the same issue with [product_name] 2040, describing connection interruptions with [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing ongoing connection issues between a [product_name] Basis Module and a [product_name] communication module, particularly inability to form a secure connection and trouble identifying device reachability based on IP addresses. Error messages suggest possible problems related to device versions or network setup. This problem appears unresolved, with similar cases reported by other users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is hoping for reliable and secure communication between the [product_name] Basis Module and [product_name] communication module, along with clear notifications regarding device status and compatibility.
